nodes.name: Schedule: 1st of Month
nodes.notes: Triggers on the 1st of each month at 7:00 AM UTC (2:00 AM COT)

nodes.name: 1. Define Seed Keywords

assignments.name: seed_keywords
assignments.value: =["registrar marca colombia", "propiedad intelectual colombia", "patentes colombia", "derechos de autor colombia", "registro de marca SIC"]

nodes.notes: Configure seed keywords and filter parameters for DataForSEO API

nodes.name: 2. DataForSEO - Keyword Ideas
nodes.notes: Calls DataForSEO API to get keyword ideas. Requires Header Auth credential with Base64 encoded login:password

nodes.name: 3. Check API Response
nodes.notes: Validates that DataForSEO API returned success (status_code: 20000)

nodes.name: 4. Transform & Calculate Priority
nodes.notes: Filters keywords by: volume >= 100, kd <= 30, words >= 3. Calculates priority_score = (volume/10) - kd + (cpc*5)

nodes.name: API Error - Notify

parameters.subject: [MW3 SUB-K] ERROR: DataForSEO API Failed

nodes.notes: Sends error notification if DataForSEO API fails

nodes.name: 5. Save to Firestore
nodes.notes: Saves each keyword to Firestore keywords_pipeline collection

nodes.name: 6. Aggregate Results
nodes.notes: Aggregates all saved keywords for summary notification

nodes.name: 7. Build Summary
nodes.notes: Builds summary statistics for email notification

nodes.name: 8. Success Notification

parameters.subject: =[MW3 SUB-K] {{ $json.total_keywords }} Keywords Identificadas - {{ $json.batch_id }}

nodes.notes: Sends success notification with summary to marketing@carrilloabgd.com
